threat_event: E-skimming script injected into checkout pages captures card data from own-brand or client white-label checkouts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Client templates can load client tag containers on the checkout page shell; script authorization and change detection cover own-brand checkout only (14 of 61 scripts unauthorized)
affected_asset_or_process: Payment service; checkout and client templates; about 32 million card-not-present orders a year
regulatory_driver: N71-R04 (PCI DSS 6.4.3; 11.6.1); State breach laws (each state where affected individuals reside); SEC Form 8-K Item 1.05
existing_controls: Payment fields served from a dedicated payment domain; content security policy and change detection on own-brand checkout; edge WAF
treatment_plan: Remove client tag containers from the checkout page shell; script allow-list and tamper detection on all client templates; tag vendors into third-party risk (POAM-002; POAM-009)
key_risk_indicator: Unauthorized scripts on checkout pages (target 0); templates under change detection (target 100%)

threat_event: Ransomware encrypts ticketing platform workloads and venue systems across regions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Large attack surface (about 22,500 endpoints and devices, 36 venues); acquired venues on flat networks (see R-004)
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01 to SYS-09; all tier-1 processes (P05)
regulatory_driver: N71-R04 (PCI DSS 12.10.1); SEC Form 8-K Item 1.05; State breach laws (each state where affected individuals reside)
existing_controls: 24x7 SOC; EDR on 97% of endpoints; PAM; immutable backups; annual tier-1 DR tests; cyber insurance
treatment_plan: Close acquired-venue gaps (POAM-001); EDR on AV terminals; failover automation (POAM-010); annual ransomware exercise with the disclosure committee (POAM-008)
key_risk_indicator: EDR coverage; mean time to contain; tier-1 DR test results

threat_event: Patron data exported from the data warehouse with a stolen service account credential
threat_source: Cybercriminal data theft and extortion group
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 14 warehouse service accounts use passwords without key-pair authentication or network policies; credentials stored on contractor laptops
affected_asset_or_process: Data warehouse (about 41 million patron records, 10 years of order history)
regulatory_driver: N71-R05 (15 U.S.C. 45(n)); State breach laws (each state where affected individuals reside); SEC Form 8-K Item 1.05
existing_controls: Workforce SSO and MFA for people; query logging to the SIEM
treatment_plan: Key-pair authentication, network policies, and vaulted secrets for all service accounts; export volume alerts (POAM-005)
key_risk_indicator: Service accounts without key-pair authentication (target 0); large export alerts investigated

threat_event: Attacker captures card data from legacy POS terminals at an acquired venue or moves from its flat network to enterprise systems

affected_asset_or_process: AV-01 to AV-06 box offices and stands; merchant CDE
regulatory_driver: N71-R04 (PCI DSS 1.3; 2.2; 5.2; 6.3.3); State breach laws (each state where affected individuals reside)
existing_controls: Legacy firewalls; EDR on 40% of AV terminals; daily SOC review of AV firewall logs
treatment_plan: Move AV venues to the P2PE solution and SD-WAN segments; retire legacy terminals; federate identities (POAM-001; POAM-011)
key_risk_indicator: AV terminals on P2PE (target 100%); AV identities federated

threat_event: Client user account on the platform is taken over and used to issue tickets, refunds, or bulk attendee exports

affected_asset_or_process: Client console; client event and patron data
regulatory_driver: N71-R04 (PCI DSS 8.4.2); N71-R05 (15 U.S.C. 45(n)); State breach laws (each state where affected individuals reside)
existing_controls: Risk-based login throttling; tenant isolation; export logging
treatment_plan: Enforce MFA for client users; disable inactive accounts; atypical-use alerts (POAM-004)
key_risk_indicator: Client users with MFA (target 100%); inactive client accounts

threat_event: Credential stuffing takes over patron accounts to steal or transfer tickets

treatment_plan: Step-up for every transfer; retire old app versions (2026 Q4)

existing_controls: Keypad masking at the in-house center; case-note access limited to agents and supervisors
treatment_plan: Keypad masking at the overflow center; purge recordings and notes; automated card-number detection in notes (POAM-003)

key_risk_indicator: Card numbers found by monthly discovery scans (target 0)
